name: Shinohara Misaki
source:
Insurance saleslady living in a condominium near Towers Apartments. She has experienced a miscarriage. Because of this, she sees the protagonist as her own child. 

Her relationship with her husband is good. She has a lively and lovely personality, and looks younger than her actual age. She is cheerful and can get along with anyone. 

On the other hand, she tends to keep her problems bottled up. She married the protagonist's father when the protagonist was 10 years old. She is good at her job, but wants to be more like a mother. 

Special physical characteristic: Perky D cup breasts, and a tight shapely figure.

[From [url=http://www.cyberworks.jp/tink/shizuku/char.html]official site[/url]]
